mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Royal Mines of Zacualpan silver-gold district, central Mexico; underground mines (Guadalupe, San Ramon Deeps, Mirasol, Cuchara-Oscar, Noche Buena, Carlos Pacheco, San Juan) plus Veta Negra open pit feed the central Guadalupe processing plant (500+ tpd). Produced since 2005. 2025: 143,192 t milled (392 tpd); 635,778 oz Ag, 403 oz Au, 222 t Pb produced; sales 636,267 oz Ag, 393 oz Au, 223 t Pb. Revenue per tonne sold C$269.58 (+60% YoY); direct cost per tonne milled C$153.87. Q4 2025 avg grade 179 g/t Ag. New Kena vein discovery (2024) and shift toward higher-grade silver veins planned for 2026. No NI 43-101 reserves or resources declared for Zacualpan. Capire open-pit silver project (16 km SW) on care and maintenance; Capire has NI 43-101 inferred 4.5 Moz Ag, 48 Mlb Zn, 21 Mlb Pb.

100%-owned high-grade zinc-lead-silver CRD mine, Chihuahua, Mexico (acquired April 2023 from Consolidated Zinc). 2025: 46,875 t milled (128 tpd; +20% YoY); avg head grades 9.1% Zn, 5.5% Pb, 34.8 g/t Ag; zinc concentrate 5,575 t, lead concentrate 1,229 t; sales 2,735 t Zn, 671 t Pb, 32,664 oz Ag. Revenue per tonne sold $211.02; direct cost per production tonne $287.60. Plagued by poor ground conditions and lower grades; company recorded an $8.8M non-cash impairment in Q4 2025 and made the decision to suspend Plomosas operations going into 2026 while evaluating alternatives. Prior operator (CZL) reported JORC resources of 215 kt @ 13.5% Zn, 6.3% Pb, 34 g/t Ag indicated and 772 kt @ 13.1% Zn, 3.0% Pb, 19 g/t Ag inferred (Dec 2021; not NI 43-101).

notes: Tickers: IPT (TSX-V); ISVLF (OTCQX); IKL (Frankfurt). All financial figures in CAD. FY2025 consolidated revenue C$48.5M (+52% YoY, record); net loss C$10.3M (2024: $9.8M), incl. $8.8M non-cash Plomosas impairment and $1.2M share-based comp; loss before income taxes C$8.3M. Working capital C$31.7M (vs $9.0M at Dec 31, 2024); no long-term debt. Total attributable silver production 668,442 oz (Zacualpan 635,778 + Plomosas 32,664); gold 403 oz. President/CEO Fred Davidson. No NI 43-101-compliant reserves; production decisions historically based on internal data.
